screens.screen: home tab: map of open freight requests (green pins) with bottom navigation
orders tab: tracking-number card and order cards
my offers (customer, offer and shipment details)

notes: Flutter (Material 3, Arabic RTL), same visual system as the shipper app (primary #25be6f, JF Flat, Iconly-Broken, bottom-nav SVGs from assets/images). bar_home.svg is not valid XML as shipped (duplicate attribute on off-canvas glyphs, no viewBox), so a cleaned local copy (same paths) is used for the nav icon. Drawn as the code is: order status prints the raw API value (in_progress / accepted / complete); in 'my offers' the code prints service.originAddress in both the 'from' and 'to' rows, so the same street appears twice (and the real getAddress() may fall back to an error string - a sample street is shown instead); the white ServiceCardView sits on a white card as in code. Currency comes from the wallet API - 'SDG' is a sample; names, prices, ids and times are sample data. Google Maps is replaced by a neutral stylised map with generic green pins (code: default marker, hueGreen; camera on Khartoum). Home is intentionally just map + pins + nav, as in code.
